title: Chwinamul Tagine with Eastern Flair
description: A delicious and aromatic tagine dish from the Eastern Mediterranean, featuring tender and roasted chwinamul, a classic Middle Eastern ingredient.

ingredients.name: Middle eastern spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the roasted and tender chwinamul, along with the Middle Eastern spices, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chwinamul is tender.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
